arxiv-2102-01582.title: Size Matters
arxiv-2102-01582.creator: Mats L. Richter, Wolf Byttner, Ulf Krumnack, Ludwig Schallner, Justin Shenk
arxiv-2102-01582.description: Abstract Fully convolutional neural networks can process input of arbitrary size by applying a combination of downsampling and pooling. However, we find that fully convolutional image classifiers are not agnostic to the input size but rather show significant differences in performance: presenting the same image at different scales can result in different outcomes.

arxiv-2204-08034.title: Optimal reinforcement learning near the edge of synchronization transition
arxiv-2204-08034.creator: Mahsa Khoshkhou, Afshin Montakhab
arxiv-2204-08034.description: Abstract Recent experimental and theoretical studies have indicated that the putative criticality of cortical dynamics may corresponds to a synchronization phase transition. The critical dynamics near such a critical point needs further investigation specifically when compared to the critical behavior near the standard absorbing state phase transition.

arxiv-2306-10223.title: Machine learning search for stable binary Sn alloys with Na, Ca, Cu, Pd, and Ag
arxiv-2306-10223.creator: Aidan Thorn, Daviti Gochitashvili, Saba Kharabadze, and Aleksey N. Kolmogorov
arxiv-2306-10223.description: Abstract We present our findings of a large-scale screening for new synthesizable materials in five M-Sn binaries, M = Na, Ca, Cu, Pd, and Ag. The focus on these systems was motivated by the known richness of M-Sn properties with potential applications in energy storage, electronics packaging, and superconductivity.

arxiv-2506-19158.title: Embedding SL ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) / ℤ 2 \mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{C})/\mathbb{Z}_{2} in Complex Riemannian Geometry
arxiv-2506-19158.creator: J. W. Moffat, E. J. Thompson
arxiv-2506-19158.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. W. Moffat, E. J. Thompson. We present a unified framework demonstrating how the spinor complex Lorentz group SL ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) / ℤ 2 \mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{C})/\mathbb{Z}_{2} is realized as a canonical subgroup within a four-dimensional complex Riemannian manifold. Building on the complex, holomorphic metric extension and contour-integration regularization of classical singularities, we show that promoting the metric to a complex-valued tensor on a complex 4-fold enlarges the frame bundle to SO ⁡ ( 4 , ℂ ) \mathrm{SO}(4,\mathbb{C}) .

arxiv-2509-12282.title: AIssistant: An Agentic Approach for Human–AI Collaborative Scientific Work on Reviews and Perspectives in Machine Learning
arxiv-2509-12282.creator: Sasi Kiran Gaddipati †, Farhana Keya †, Gollam Rabby, Sören Auer
arxiv-2509-12282.description: Abstract Advances in AI-assisted research have introduced powerful tools for literature retrieval, hypothesis generation, experimentation, and manuscript preparation. However, systems remain fragmented and lack human-centered workflows. To address these gaps, we introduce AIssistant , an agentic, open-source Human-AI collaborative framework designed to simplify the end-to-end creation of scientific workflows.

pmc-12401077.title: Hypothermic Oxygenated Perfusion Versus Static Cold Storage in Transplantation of Extended Criteria Liver Grafts: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-12401077.creator: Valberto Sanha, Bruna Oliveira Trindade, Sangeeta Satish, Laura Batista de Oliveira, Omer Faruk Karakaya, Chunbao Jiao, Keyue Sun, Muhammad Ahmad Nadeem, Charles Miller, Koji Hashimoto, Chase J. Wehrle, Andrea Schlegel
pmc-12401077.description: BackgroundThe use of extended criteria donor livers (ECD) is becoming more routine in many transplant centers. These organs have higher risks for complications; however, hypothermic‐oxygenated perfusion (HOPE) was found to improve outcomes, including graft survival. We aim to assess the effect of HOPE on different types of ECD liver grafts.

pmc-12449020.title: Investigating the use of physics informed neural networks for dam-break scenarios
pmc-12449020.creator: Kinza Mumtaz, Muhammad Waasif Nadeem, Adnan Khan, Zahra Lakdawala, Divyesh Varade, Divyesh Varade, Divyesh Varade
pmc-12449020.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The real-time forecasting of flood dynamics is a long-standing challenge traditionally addressed through numerical solutions of the Shallow Water Equations (SWEs). Numerical solutions of realistic flow problems using numerical schemes are often hindered by high computational costs, particularly due to the need for fine spatial and temporal discretization, complex boundary conditions, and the resolution of non-linearities inherent in the governing equations. In this study, we investigate the use of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve 1D and 2D SWEs in dam-break scenarios.

pmc-12650402.title: The Role of Mitochondrial Genome Stability and Metabolic Plasticity in Thyroid Cancer
pmc-12650402.creator: Lingyu Ren, Wei Liu, Jiaojiao Zheng, Qiao Wu, Zhilong Ai
pmc-12650402.description: Mitochondria play a central role in energy metabolism, redox homeostasis, and signal transduction in the thyroid cells. Increasing evidence indicates that mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations, copy number variations, and haplogroup-specific polymorphisms are closely associated with metabolic reprogramming and malignant progression of thyroid cancer.

pmc-12715253.title: β2-adrenergic signaling controls neonatal respiratory syncytial virus infection by promoting viral clearance and airway protection
pmc-12715253.creator: Sandeep Adhikari, Camille Carrier, Prabhu Raj Joshi, Pankaj Baral
pmc-12715253.description: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the most common cause of acute bronchiolitis and pneumonia in children under 5 years of age. RSV infection is characterized by lung inflammation, viral expansion, and airway barrier destruction. The crosstalk between neurons and immune and non-immune cells develops from early life onwards.
